RPSC SI / Platoon Commander PET Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has released the PET Result for the post of Sub Inspector / Platoon Commander. This recruitment was issued for 1050 posts. The PET Exam was held on 03-13 August 2026. Online applying process for Rajasthan RPSC RPSC SI / Platoon Commander Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 10 August 2025 to 08 September 2025. Candidates can Download their RPSC SI / Platoon Commander PET Result 2026 which has given below.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
